title: Viewport Meta Tag + Touch/Scroll CSS Optimizations
content:
Two independent CSS/meta fixes:

**A1 — Viewport meta tag (Critical)**
Root layout `src/app/layout.tsx` is missing Next.js 14+ `viewport` export. Without it, mobile browsers may render at incorrect zoom levels.
- Add `export const viewport = { width: 'device-width', initialScale: 1 }` to root layout

**A2 — Touch/scroll CSS (Moderate)**
Missing mobile scroll optimization properties in `src/app/globals.css`:
- `* { -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch }`
- `body { touch-action: manipulation; overscroll-behavior: none }`
- Scroll containers: `overscroll-behavior: contain`

Files:
- src/app/layout.tsx
- src/app/globals.css
acceptance: Root layout exports viewport config with width=device-width, initial-scale=1
globals.css includes touch-action: manipulation on body
globals.css includes overscroll-behavior: none on body
Scroll containers (admin tables, course lists) use overscroll-behavior: contain
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && open /en/courses in Chrome mobile emulation — page renders at correct zoom, scrolling is smooth
